command: claude CLI 2.1.285 print mode (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <porting system prompt>, prompt file on stdin, run from an empty directory)
notes:
Defects of the original kept (behaviour unchanged, commented in the code):
- BLINK-MISTAKE moves X'F1' to MSGA (the attribute byte: autoskip + MDT) instead of the highlight byte.
  This is the program's own deliberate demonstration. Fix: MOVE DFHBLINK TO MSGH.
- CHECK-INPUT never tests WS-RESP after RECEIVE MAP (fact "unchecked_responses", field-tested).
  On MAPFAIL, HXM2I stays LOW-VALUES and ACCTL = 0, so the task sends "ACCOUNT MUST BE 6 DIGITS".
  Fix: IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(MAPFAIL) resend the first-entry screen.
- AMOUNT is never validated; its NUM attribute only restricts the keyboard. When AMOUNT is not
  entered, AMOUNTI stays LOW-VALUES. Those X'00' bytes then go into MSGO through the STRING, and
  back out as AMOUNTO on the DATAONLY send.
  Fix: IF AMOUNTL = 0 MOVE ZEROS TO AMOUNTI before the STRING.

Modelling notes:
- HXM2O REDEFINES HXM2I. On both CHECK-INPUT sends, ACCTO and AMOUNTO therefore carry the received
  ACCTI / AMOUNTI data. Received data is modelled as BMS lays it out:
  - ACCT uses JUSTIFY=(LEFT,BLANK).
  - AMOUNT uses JUSTIFY=(RIGHT,ZERO).
  - ACCTL is the length of the value typed.
  - A field that is null or empty is treated as not received: length 0, LOW-VALUES.
- Hxm2Screen carries no received flag bytes (ACCTF / AMOUNTF / MSGF). On the CHECK-INPUT sends,
  AMOUNTA and MSGA keep whatever flag BMS set (X'80' after an erase-EOF). They are ported as not
  set, i.e. LOW-VALUES. On the error path ACCTA is overwritten.
- EIBCALEN = 0 is tested as !task.hasCommarea(), or eibcalen() == 0.

Facts contradicted: none found. The screen_bindings, calls, commarea_contracts and cics_resources
facts (field testing open) all match the source.
